representations.name: Symbolic (analytical) expression
representations.description: Information given as an algebraic formula, equation, or closed-form function rule; the CED calls this the analytical representation in Practice 2 skills 2.B, 2.C, 2.E.

representations.name: Graphical
representations.description: Information given as the graph of a function, its derivative, or a related curve, read for values, slopes, signs, areas, and behaviour; named in Practice 2 skills 2.B and 2.E.

representations.name: Numerical table
representations.description: Information given as selected values of a function or rate in a table; named as the numerical representation in Practice 2.

representations.name: Verbal description
representations.description: Information stated in words about a function, rate, or quantity without a formula, graph, or table; named as the verbal representation in Practice 2.

representations.name: Contextual model
representations.description: A real-world scenario with units in which a function or rate models a quantity; overlaps verbal but adds units and interpretation demands assessed under skills 1.D, 3.F, 4.B.

representations.name: Differential equation
representations.description: A relation between a function and its derivatives given as an equation, with or without an initial condition.

representations.name: Slope field
representations.description: A grid of short line segments showing the slope prescribed by a differential equation at sample points.

representations.name: Geometric diagram
representations.description: A figure (solid, region, triangle, cone, ladder) from which relationships among lengths, areas, and volumes must be read for related rates, optimisation, or volume problems.

representations.name: Calculator-generated numerical result
representations.description: A value produced by graphing-calculator capability (zero, numerical derivative, numerical integral, graph in a window); the CED requires the setup and the result to be written.

representations.name: Sequence
representations.description: An ordered list of terms given by formula, recursion, or listed values.

representations.name: Series (finite partial sums or infinite)
representations.description: A sum of sequence terms given in sigma notation, expanded form, or as a power series with a centre.

representations.name: Parametric equations
representations.description: A curve given by x(t), y(t), including motion interpretations.

representations.name: Polar equation
representations.description: A curve given by r as a function of theta, usually with a graph.

representations.name: Vector-valued function
representations.description: Position, velocity, or acceleration given as a vector of component functions.
